Classification falls under heading 3307, which covers pre-shave, shaving and after-shave preparations, through subheading 3307.10. Within that subheading, the 3307.10.10 provision for preparations containing alcohol has historically been "Containing alcohol and not over 10 percent by weight of fragrant oils." CBP rulings classify alcohol-based after-shave lotions under 3307.10.1000, but I am going from memory on the exact wording. I could not confirm from the description that fragrant oils are 10 percent or less by weight, which this subheading would require. I chose it because it is the specific provision for after-shave preparations that contain alcohol.
